Qasr Al Mazraa Palace — 90 SAR per person. Explore a historic palace and learn how its rooms, grounds and former farming estate were used. An audio guide, tactile floor paths and staff assistance on request make it a good heritage option for your needs. Parking is 100 m from the entrance.
